project_config.py:1084-1170 pinned context and entry point resolution

findings.summary: Local configuration exclusion compares raw path basenames against lowercase constants. On Windows, differently cased names can resolve to the same case-insensitive file while bypassing these exact string checks, potentially admitting the local configuration file to project scanning.
findings.evidence: The Windows path glob normalizer lowercases values at lines 1346-1352; extension matching casefolds names at lines 465-468. Local config exclusion does neither. Current transferred tests use lowercase config filenames; no case-variant regression was found by bounded search.
findings.recommended_owner_action: T21 owner should normalize basename comparisons consistently and add Windows coverage for path_is_allowed and may_descend with case-variant local config names.
findings.acceptance_effect: Keep project_config acceptance open until owner review and an assigned serial regression selector establish the intended Windows behavior.

validation: Read-only source and bounded test-name inspection only; no tests or runtime probes run.
ownership: T21-owned source/test were read only; no source changes made.
